# Spwashi

> I'm Spwashi. I build software and make art. This site documents Spw (a symbolic seed and structure notation), the spw-workbench language tooling, fluid layered CSS studies, interactive tools, physical/laminated art folios, and tabletop RPG worlds.

## How to read this site

- Canonical public pages live at clean directory paths (`/now/`, `/tools/spw-parser/`, `/design/experiments/css/`). Avoid indexing `?spw_source=` or `?spw_sample=` query permutations; see `/robots.txt`.
- Machine-readable and author-facing `.spw` specification files live under `/.spw/` as plain UTF-8 text. Lines use sigils (`#>` anchor, `#:` layer/role header, `@` reference, `^` facet/integration, `?` probe, `~` potential/ref, `!` action, `*` verify) and containers (`{}`, `[]`, `()`, `<>`). `.spw/_workbench/` and `/.agents/` are excluded from production deploys.
- Every route also embeds `data-spw-semantic-expression` handles on key sections and keeps interactive tools usable as static HTML.

## Core Orientation & Studies

- [Home](https://spwashi.com/): Creator landing surface, live Spw paste prompt, and primary constellation doors.
- [Now & Active Studies](https://spwashi.com/now/#studies): Current focus, cycle receipts, and active studies across software studies, mechanics studies, and studies in dynamics.
- [About](https://spwashi.com/about/): Biography, resume practices, and ecosystem background.
- [Ten-Domain Constellation](https://spwashi.com/about/domains/): Map of connected sites (`spw.quest`, `factshift.center`, `attention.productions`, `texture.website`, `lore.land`, and sibling rooms).

## Language, Workbench & Interactive Tools

- [Spw Language Hub](https://spwashi.com/topics/software/spw/): Operator atlas, join crawl semantics, expressiveness goals, and language evolution (`v0.4` capability contracts).
- [Spw Workbench & Agent Queue](https://spwashi.com/projects/spw-workbench/): Architecture overview for `spw-seed`/`spw-runtime`/`spw-lsp`/`spw-cli`, live `bcf0da18` corpus parse census, open parser issues, and the prioritized P0–P3 development queue.
- [Editor Tooling](https://spwashi.com/topics/software/editor-tooling/): Language server, syntax inspection, and editor integration direction.
- [Parsers](https://spwashi.com/topics/software/parsers/): Parsing notes and grammar architecture.
- [Literal Spw Parser](https://spwashi.com/tools/spw-parser/): Interactive browser parser backed by the pinned `spw-workbench` reader (`tokens`, `AST`, `diagnostics`, `outline`, and lossless token reconstruction).
- [Character Sheet](https://spwashi.com/tools/character-sheet/): Tabletop character sheet workspace.
- [Tools Index](https://spwashi.com/tools/): Registry of interactive browser tools.
- [Software Topics](https://spwashi.com/topics/software/): Index of software architecture notes.

## For `spw-workbench` Agents (What to Develop Next)

`spwashi.com` is the primary live test corpus for `spw-workbench` (mounted at `.spw/_workbench` pin `bcf0da18b840`: 1,322 `.spw` files, 1,035 distinct HTML expressions, and `spw.quest`'s 157 worker tests). Start here when deciding what to fix or build upstream:

- [Prioritized P0–P3 Development Queue (with parseable Spw manifest)](https://spwashi.com/projects/spw-workbench/#workbench-backlog): Ranked `spw-seed` / `spw-cli` / `spw-lsp` / consumer-contract priorities with minimal repros and acceptance checks.
- [Open Parsing Issues (`bcf0da18` live census)](https://spwashi.com/projects/spw-workbench/#parsing-issues): Five open issue classes — container-order & prefix/`Persona@` AST asymmetry, greedy digraph priority, tokenizer drops/escapes, prose degradation, and trailing units/slot readers.
- [Expressiveness Goals & Workbench Improvements](https://spwashi.com/topics/software/spw/#expressiveness-goals): Eight falsifiable language goals and historical consumer measurements (`/topics/software/spw/#workbench-improvements`).
- [Measured Consumer Report (`workbench-report.spw`)](https://spwashi.com/.spw/workbench-report.spw): Timed probes, CLI memo keys, LSP `documentSymbol` reparse latency, trace-cost profiles, and Nov 19 container-variety AST receipts.
- [Upstream Recommendations (`upstream-workbench-recommendations.spw`)](https://spwashi.com/.spw/reviews/upstream-workbench-recommendations.spw): Synthesized capability contracts (`operator.table/1`, `inquiry.loop/1`, `reading.ground-edge/1`, `citation.resolve/1`) and themed ask tree.
- [Expression Stagnation & Container Variety Cache](https://spwashi.com/.spw/caches/expression-stagnation-and-variety-2026-11.spw): Empirical 1,033-expression census, parse matrix, cross-domain utility audit, and exact parser ceilings hit on `spwashi.com` and `spw.quest`.
- [Factshift Navigation, Scrub Grains & Operator Physics](https://spwashi.com/.spw/caches/factshift-navigation-and-physics-2026-11.spw): Spatial fulcrum direction across `spw.quest`, `attention.productions`, and `factshift.center` — arrivals, eight-way navigation, five scrub grains, and six-pair operator physics.
- [Algorithmic Practicality Cache](https://spwashi.com/.spw/caches/workbench-algorithmic-practicality-2026-11.spw): Digraph priority, single-pass scanner, and bounded recovery notes.

## Public `.spw` Caches & Conventions

- [Site Orientation (`site.spw`)](https://spwashi.com/.spw/site.spw): Top-level map linking publishing surfaces, conventions, caches, and workbench mount paths.
- [Caches Index (`caches/index.spw`)](https://spwashi.com/.spw/caches/index.spw): Master catalog of research judgments, design precipitates, and active operational notes.
- [Plugin Ecology Improvements](https://spwashi.com/.spw/caches/plugin-ecology-improvements-2026-11.spw): Deep technical notes for VS Code, JetBrains, Neovim, Vite, and plugin transport contracts.
- [Streaming Attention & Rooms](https://spwashi.com/.spw/caches/streaming-attention-rooms-2026-11.spw): Attention economics across live streams, physical media, room contracts, and collectible Spw expressions.
- [CSS Cascade Stratification](https://spwashi.com/.spw/caches/css-cascade-stratification-2026-09.spw): Layer model organized as care signal from substrate (`reset`) to reader (`ornament`).
- [Spw as Handle](https://spwashi.com/.spw/caches/spw-as-handle-2026-09.spw): Unified expression grammar across search, cauldron, satchel, and `texture.website`.
- [Cognitive Toy](https://spwashi.com/.spw/caches/cognitive-toy-2026-09.spw): Electrostatic interaction loops and wonder/promo pacing.
- [Copy Hypermedia Key](https://spwashi.com/.spw/caches/copy-hypermedia-key-2026-09.spw): First-fold voice, copy-unit addressing, and hypermedia verification.
- [Spw Tree Shape](https://spwashi.com/.spw/caches/spw-tree-shape-2026-11.spw): Filing taxonomy and subject-projection conventions across `.spw/`.
- [Conventions Index](https://spwashi.com/.spw/conventions/index.spw): Registry of site semantic conventions.
- [Wonder Architecture](https://spwashi.com/.spw/conventions/wonder-architecture.spw): Six altitudes and seven types of wonder across doctrine, field, and ornament.
- [Copy Accessor](https://spwashi.com/.spw/conventions/copy-accessor.spw): Dotted localization keys (`data-spw-copy-unit`) vs. multidimensional `data-spw-semantic-expression` handles.
- [Language Utilization](https://spwashi.com/.spw/language/feature-utilization.spw): Spw language operators and v0.4 syntax capabilities kept distinct from browser runtime feature packs.
- [Page Model](https://spwashi.com/.spw/surfaces/page-model.spw): Canonical shell surfaces, wonders, roles, and modes.
- [Product Lines](https://spwashi.com/.spw/surfaces/product-lines.spw): Creator offers, audiences, proofs, and collaborator lanes.
